newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Telepizza delivers a slice in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Telepizza delivers a slice in IPO.

text.p: Spain's pizza delivery chain Telepizza launched an initial public offering on Monday for 42 percent of its capital, according to an official document presented to the stock market commission and media reports.
The offering, lead managed by BBV, could be increased to 45 percent and will consist of a national and an international tranche.
The national tranche will place 2.7 million shares, divided between institutional and retail investors with most allocated to retail. In the international tranche, 1.8 million shares will be placed.
The public offering will close on November 8 and will be priced on November 10. Shares are expected to sell for between 2,000 and 2,300 pesetas. The shares begin trading on November 13.
Retail investors will receive a discount of three percent on the launch price.
The offer is expected to be oversubscribed and if so, shares will be distributed on a pro rata basis.
The shares on offer come partly from Eduardo Fernandez Pujals, brother of the company president, who holds 32 percent.
BBV, which owns 18 percent, will sell nine percent and the rest will come from retail share holders.
Company president Leopoldo Fernandez Pujals holds 45 percent of the capital.
